questions.solution: Enervated means to weaken or exhaust. Weaken means to reduce the strength, power, or effectiveness of something. Therefore, the correct synonym for enervated is weaken.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word in the given sentence. We have always been told retaliation is not the key to resolving problems.
questions.questionHtml:

questions.solution: Retaliation means an act of revenge or reprisal. Example: Sarah decided on a subtle retaliation by playing a harmless prank on her mischievous colleague. questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. Judicious
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Judicious
questions.solution: Judicious means having or showing good judgment or sense. Marked option Sensible means having or showing good sense or practical judgment. Example: The CEO made a sensible decision to invest in new technology to improve efficiency.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. Extinct

questions.solution: Extinct means no longer in existence or happening. Vanished means disappeared suddenly and completely. Example- "The once-thriving species of dinosaurs has completely vanished from the Earth and is now considered extinct." So, 'vanished' is a suitable synonym for 'extinct'.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. Glorify

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word. The boxer showed audacity by agreeing to fight the champion.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the highlighted word in the given sentence. A strong man is a mediator between divine and mortal fate.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the highlighted word in the given sentence. 

A strong man is a mediator between divine and mortal fate.
questions.solution:
The correct option is: Lethal.

Key Points

  • "Mortal" in this context refers to something that is subject to death or fatal. (नश्वर)

  • "Lethal" means sufficient to cause death, which is synonymous with "mortal" when discussing fate. (घातक)
    • For Example: A single dose of the substance was lethal enough to endanger life.
  • The term "mortal" is frequently used in existential discussions, as well as in the context of human vulnerability and the inevitability of death.
  • "Delightful," "Sincere," and "Overjoyed" are not synonyms for "mortal." These words carry completely 

Therefore, the correct answer is 'option 4'.

Additional Information

  • In literature and philosophy, the concept of mortality often addresses the nature of human existence and the contrast between life and death, the ephemeral and the eternal.
  • "Delightful" refers to something very pleasant. (आनंददायक)

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. Fragile
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Fragile
questions.solution:
The correct synonym is: Delicate.

Key Points

  • "Fragile" means easily broken or damaged.(नाजुक)
  • "Delicate" has a similar meaning, indicating that something is fine in texture or structure and easily broken or damaged. (नाजुक)
    • For example, "The artisan crafted a series of delicate, fragile glass sculptures that required careful handling."
  • "Firm," "Composed," and "Fanatic" do not share the same meaning as "fragile."

Therefore, the correct answer is: Delicate.

Additional Information

  • "Firm" is an antonym of "fragile," meaning having a solid, unyielding surface or structure. (मजबूत)
    • ​For example: The mattress was too firm for her liking.
  • "Composed" refers to being calm and in control of oneself, which does not relate to the physical property of being fragile. (संयत)
    • ​For example: Despite the chaos around him, he remained composed.
  • "Fanatic" describes a person filled with excessive and single-minded zeal, especially for an extreme religious or political cause, which is unrelated to the concept of fragility. (कट्टर)
    • ​For example: He's a sports fanatic, never missing a game of his favorite team.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence. In most organizations, some predators take over the meek ones.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

In most organizations, some  predators  take over the meek ones.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: exploiters.

Key Points

  •  The word "predators" in the given context refers to those who unfairly take advantage of others, which is synonymous with "exploiters."
  • "Exploiters" is the synonym that closely matches "predators" in this context, referring to people who unfairly or unethically use others for their own advantage. (शोषक)
  • "Exploiters" are individuals or groups that take advantage of others, typically in an unfair or unethical manner.
    • For example, "The report revealed that the factory was full of exploiters who preyed on the vulnerability of the migrant workers."
  • "Supporters," "philanthropists," and "benefactors" have positive connotations and are therefore not suitable synonyms for "predators" in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Exploiters.

Additional Information

  • "Supporters" are people who are in favor of something or someone, which is not synonymous with "predators." (समर्थक)
    • For example: The political candidate thanked her supporters for their unwavering faith.
  • "Philanthropists" are individuals who seek to promote the welfare of others, typically by donating money to good causes, the opposite of exploitation.  (परोपकारी)
    • ​For example: The philanthropist donated millions to charity.
  • "Benefactors" are people who give help or financial aid, which is also contrary to the concept of "predators."  (हितैषी)
    • ​For example: The school's benefactors funded the construction of the new library.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. Hostile
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Hostile
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "Unfriendly."

Key Points
  •  Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
    • Hostile means unfriendly, aggressive, or antagonistic.
      • Example: People are very hostile to the idea.
    • Unfriendly is a synonym of hostile, and it means not kind or pleasant.
      • Example: They exchanged a few unfriendly words and left.
  • Grammatical point: Adjectives like hostile and unfriendly are used to describe a person or thing.
  • Thus, it can be concluded that the word "unfriendly" is the correct synonym of the word "hostile."

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Additional Information

  • Pleasant (Option 1) means enjoyable or agreeable, which is the opposite of hostile.
  • Hospitable (Option 2) means friendly and welcoming to guests or strangers, which is also the opposite of hostile.
  • Empathetic (Option 3) means understanding and sharing the feelings of others, which is not related to hostility.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. Rectify
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
Rectify
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. amend.

Key Points

  • The word "rectify" means to correct something or make it right. (सही करना)
    • Example: She tried to rectify her mistake by apologizing to everyone involved.
  • "Amend" refers to making changes to something in order to improve it or correct it. (संशोधित करना)
    • Example: The government decided to amend the existing law to better protect the environment.
  • Hence, we can infer that the synonym of 'rectify' is 'amend'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. amend.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • Mar (बिगाड़ना): To spoil, impair, or damage something.
    • Example: The graffiti marred the beauty of the historic building.
  • Corrupt (भ्रष्ट): Having or showing a willingness to act dishonestly in return for money or personal gain.
    • Example: The corrupt official was eventually caught and prosecuted.
  • Upset (परेशान): To make someone unhappy, disappointed, or worried.
    • Example: The news of her friend's accident upset her greatly.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. Celebrate
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
Celebrate
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Rejoice.

Key Points

  • The word "Celebrate" means to acknowledge a significant or happy day or event with a social gathering or enjoyable activity. (मनाना)
    • Example: We will celebrate her birthday with a big party.
  • "Rejoice" means to feel or show great joy or delight. (आनंदित होना)
    • Example: The whole community rejoiced when the team won the championship.
  • Hence, we can infer that the synonym of 'Celebrate' is 'Rejoice'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Rejoice.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • Daunt (हतोत्साहित करना): To make someone feel intimidated or apprehensive.
    • Example: The difficulty of the task did not daunt him.
  • Birch (बिर्च का पेड़): A type of tree with smooth, white bark.
    • Example: The birch trees in the forest were very tall and beautiful.
  • Assure (आश्वासन देना): To tell someone something positively or confidently to dispel any doubts they may have.
    • Example: I assure you that everything will be fine.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. Thankful

Thankful

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. Labour

Additional Information

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. Exceptional

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. Fallacy
